latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Text to Video Kids: instantly convert your story text into animated kids videos with narration and bright visuals.
- Supports TXT, DOCX, PDF, RTF file uploads up to 200MB; cloud AI handles video creation—no editing skills required.
- Simple onboarding: automatic sign-in with free starter token (100 credits for 7 days) if no account token is provided.
- Intuitive workflow: upload stories, give instructions, and download 1080p MP4 videos in 1–2 minutes.
- Designed for parents, teachers, and creators to easily generate engaging children’s video content with audio and animation.
- Built-in commands for uploading, rendering/export, credit checks, and timeline previews.
